archetype: Asset-light urban redeveloper with crown-jewel master land bank
primer: Ajmera Realty & Infra India Limited (NSE: AJMERA) is an integrated Mumbai residential and commercial developer operating a dual engine. It pairs high-margin construction on its contiguous Wadala land bank (~₹15,950 Cr GDV) with high-ROCE asset-light society redevelopment across central suburbs. Having deleveraged debt-to-equity from 1.52x down to 0.44x, the company expanded FY26 pre-sales by 57% to ₹1,701 Cr. The stock trades at an attractive GARP valuation of 15.6x TTM P/E with confirmed Stage 2 technical structure.
